elite.rules: Forty years in the bog, and you just called her cauldron 'fine'. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She makes you drink the whole pot. Drink 8.
She makes you drink the whole pot. Drink 4.
You call it her best. She weeps. Give 4.
Natural 20! You call it her best. She weeps. Give 8.

elite.title: The Thing in the Peat
elite.rules: Something has slept in the peat for a thousand years. It's awake. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's very old and very strong. Drink 8.
It's very old and very strong. Drink 4.
You bury it again. Give 4 to the oldest player here.
Natural 20! You bury it again. Give 8 to the oldest player here.

spoils.name: Ancient Amulet
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

elite.title: The Lizard King
elite.rules: The lizardfolk's king wants the marsh, one boardwalk at a time. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes your boardwalk. Drink 8.
He takes your boardwalk. Drink 4.
You take his. Take someone's drink for a sip; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You take his. Take someone's drink for a sip; they drink 8.

spoils.name: Scaled Pack
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Tower Shield.

elite.title: The Leech Queen
elite.rules: She's fed on every traveler since 1098, and she likes your type. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She sucks your neck. Enjoy the hickey. Drink 8.
She sucks your neck. Enjoy the hickey. Drink 4.
She asks your blood type. Make one up out loud, then give 4.
Natural 20! She asks your blood type. Make one up out loud, then give 8.

cards.title: The Sunken Chapel
cards.rules: A chapel up to its windows in mud, and the bell still rings. Last to bow their head drinks 2.

cards.title: The Hag's Bargain
cards.rules: She'll trade something you have for something you need. The drawer shakes her clammy hand.

cards.title: The Ferry of Frogs
cards.rules: A raft poled by frogs, and the fare is a song. Everyone croaks the chorus.

cards.title: The Wishing Frog
cards.rules: A frog in a crown offers three wishes, but you only get one. The drawer chooses.

cards.title: The Will-o'-Wisp
cards.rules: A blue light bobs off the path, singing your name. Everyone hums along.

cards.title: The Bog Hydra
cards.rules: Five heads, all hungry, and two of them are making out. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! A head gets you. Drink 8.
A head gets you. Drink 4.
You cut one off. Two grow back, slower. Give 5.
Natural 20! You tie two heads in a knot. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: The heads argue over you. Hold one note while the table counts to ten. Run out of air: drink 3.

cards.title: The Frog King
cards.rules: A cart-sized frog in a crown. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He swallows you. Finish your drink.
He sits on you, naked. Drink 4.
You knock his crown into the bog. Give 5.
Natural 20! You knock his crown into the bog. Give 10.

phases.rules: He wants his court flattered. Croak his praises for 15 seconds. Laugh or stall: drink 3.

cards.title: The Drowned Lich
cards.rules: A lich who sank in the marsh and has been complaining ever since. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He complains until you drown. Drink 8.
He complains until you drown. Drink 4.
You fall asleep, and it bores him to death. Give 5.
Natural 20! You out-complain him. Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Moist
jinx.rule: Nobody says 'wet'; it's 'moist'. Slip: drink 1.

phases.rules: Name swamp creatures back and forth with your left neighbor. Stall or repeat first: drink 3.

cards.title: The Marsh Serpent
cards.rules: Eight coils, each as thick as a tree. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It pulls you under. Finish your drink.
Squeezed. Drink 4.
You tie its coils in a knot. Give 5.
Natural 20! You tie its coils in a knot. Give 10.

spoils.name: Serpent's Eye
spoils.rules: +2 to ambush d20s. Comes with a Smoke Bomb.

phases.rules: It thrashes, coils everywhere. Roll 2d6 to break free.

outcomes.instruction: Squeezed. Drink 4.
You slip loose. Give 4.

dice.doubles: You tie it to a tree. Give 6.

cards.title: The Baron of the Bog
cards.rules: He drained half the marsh for a manor, and he's pissing on you to celebrate. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He sprays you. It isn't bog water. Drink 8.
He sprays you. It isn't bog water. Drink 4.
You read his deed. The marsh owns him. Give 5.
Natural 20! You flood the manor. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Baron's Purse
spoils.rules: Comes with a Hired Sword and a Lucky Coin.

phases.rules: He offers you a job at the manor. Roll d6 to negotiate.

outcomes.instruction: Stable hand: you shovel shit. Drink 4.
Paid in turnips. Drink 3.
A room and a horse. Give 3.
A title. Give 3.
You buy the manor. Give 4.
You flood it. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Lordly
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'my good fellow' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Sir Chad Thundercock
cards.rules: Sir Chad Thundercock arrives once the boss is dead. Everyone flexes; the weakest drinks 2.

profile.name: Sir Chad
profile.ritual: When Sir Chad shows up, everyone flexes. Weakest flex drinks 1.

lines.took: Sir Chad pockets your {item}. 'For the highlight reel, Champ.'
lines.back: Sir Chad drops your {item}. 'I was holding it for you, Champ.'
lines.lostTo: Sir Chad kisses both biceps at you. 'Unlucky, Champ.'
lines.beaten: Sir Chad says he let you win. Nobody believes him.
lines.ambush: Sir Chad steps in front of you, shirt off. 'Spot me, Champ.'
lines.meddle: 'Let me show you, Champ.' Sir Chad grabs your arm. Roll twice, keep the worse.
lines.snipe: Sir Chad poses with your loot. 'Great teamwork, Champ.' It's his now.
lines.redo: 'Champ, that didn't count. Again.' Roll it again; the new roll stands.

credit.short: and Sir Chad slew it. Allegedly.

verse.joined: with Sir Chad taking all the credit,
verse.beaten: left Sir Chad crying in a ditch,
verse.ahead: two steps behind Sir Chad Thundercock,

cards.title: Lady Fingerbang
cards.rules: Lady Fingerbang admires your things. 'Mine,' she says. Everyone covers a drink; last drinks 2.

profile.name: Lady Fingerbang
profile.ritual: When Lady Fingerbang shows up, everyone guards their drink. Last hand on it drinks 1.

lines.took: Lady Fingerbang was here. Check your pockets: your {item}, gone.
lines.back: Lady Fingerbang hands back your {item}. It's a little warm.
lines.lostTo: 'Mine,' says Lady Fingerbang, already halfway out the door.
lines.beaten: Lady Fingerbang pouts, then pinches a bum on the way out.
lines.ambush: Lady Fingerbang blocks the way, licking her fingers. 'Hello, you.'
lines.meddle: Her hand is in your pocket mid-swing. Roll twice, keep the worse.
lines.swipe: Lady Fingerbang was here. Check your pockets. Your newest item is gone.
lines.poach: Lady Fingerbang winks at your ally. Your ally winks back.
lines.turned: Lady Fingerbang turns on you. Everyone who voted to take her drinks 3.
lines.snipe: Whatever this gives is already down Lady Fingerbang's top. 'Mine.'

verse.joined: with Fingerbang's hand in their pocket,
verse.beaten: took it all back from Fingerbang,

cards.title: Sensei Saggynuts
cards.rules: Sensei Saggynuts inspects your work. 'Hm. No.' Everyone sits up straight; slouchers drink 2.

profile.name: Sensei Saggynuts
profile.ritual: When Sensei Saggynuts shows up, everyone bows. He sees up your nose. Last to bow drinks 1.

lines.took: Sensei Saggynuts confiscates your {item}. 'You are not ready.'
lines.back: Sensei returns your {item}. 'Perhaps you are ready. Perhaps.'
lines.beaten: Sensei Saggynuts nods, once. Best day of your life.
lines.ambush: Sensei Saggynuts sits cross-legged in your path. Don't look down.
lines.meddle: 'Elbow.' Sensei corrects your form. Roll twice, keep the worse.
lines.redo: 'Lucky. Again.' Sensei makes you redo it. The new roll stands.
lines.snipe: Whatever this gives, Sensei confiscates. 'You are not ready.'

verse.saved: and carried Sensei home at last,
verse.left: and left Sensei to the dragon,

cards.rules: Chuck the Cuck is your squire now. Drawer, stare someone down as him. First to look away drinks 2.

profile.name: Chuck the Cuck
profile.ritual: When Chuck the Cuck shows up, the drawer stares someone down as him. First to look away drinks 1.

lines.took: Chuck the Cuck holds your {item} for you. He keeps holding it.
lines.back: Chuck the Cuck hands back your {item}. It's a bit damp.
lines.lostTo: Chuck the Cuck claps. Not for you.
lines.beaten: Chuck the Cuck says he liked watching that, actually.
lines.redo: Chuck the Cuck 'helps' you with that roll. Again. The new roll stands.
lines.meddle: Chuck the Cuck holds your sword for you. Roll twice, keep the worse.
lines.handoff: Chuck the Cuck lends your {item} to a nice stranger. It's gone.

verse.joined: with Chuck the Cuck just watching,
verse.beaten: sent Chuck the Cuck home to watch,
verse.ahead: while Chuck the Cuck just watched,

profile.name: Gary Shitwhistle
profile.ritual: When Gary Shitwhistle shows up, he blows his whistle. Everyone freezes; first to move drinks 1.

lines.took: Gary Shitwhistle confiscates your {item}. You'll get a receipt.
lines.back: Gary returns your {item}, with a receipt for the return.
lines.lostTo: Gary Shitwhistle stamps something. It says 'DENIED'.
lines.beaten: Gary Shitwhistle files a complaint. Against you. It takes weeks.
lines.ambush: Gary Shitwhistle steps out with a clipboard. 'A moment of your time.'
lines.invoice: Gary Shitwhistle presents an invoice. Pay a heart or an item.
lines.squat: Gary is in your bed. 'Audit,' he says. Rest heals 1 less.

cards.title: Dame Queefington
cards.rules: Dame Queefington has a song about your last fight. It rhymes 'hero' with 'zero'. Everyone hums.

profile.name: Dame Queefington
profile.ritual: When Dame Queefington plays, everyone hums along. Anyone who laughs drinks 1.

lines.took: Dame Queefington takes your {item} as payment for the song.
lines.lostTo: Dame Queefington adds a verse about that. It rhymes.
lines.beaten: Dame Queefington hits a bum note and storms off.
lines.curse: Dame Queefington writes a song about you. It's catchy. You're cursed.
lines.snipe: Dame Queefington sings for whatever this gives. It's hers now.
lines.meddle: Dame Queefington plays during your swing. Roll twice, keep the worse.
lines.turned: Dame Queefington sings for the dragon now. Everyone who voted yes drinks 3.

lines: Hear now of heroes, bold and true,
who crossed the realm with swords held high,
with Dame Queefington to light the way,
and every foe they met, they slew,
kind.won: and slew the dragon. Bravo. Encore.
kind.lost: and fell, but oh, how well they fell.

lines: Here's a song of fools who tried,
who tripped through every dungeon door,
who wouldn't hire a better bard,
and blamed the dice for all of it,
vicious.won: and won, somehow. Nobody knows how.

cards.title: The Shadow
cards.rules: A shadow crosses the sun: {dragon}. Everyone ducks and clenches. Last head down drinks 2.

cards.title: A Fallen Scale
cards.rules: A warm, sticky scale off {dragon}. Don't ask why it's sticky. Everyone touches it anyway.

cards.title: The Fleeing Knights
cards.rules: Knights gallop past the wrong way, crying '{dragon}!' Everyone shouts it too, crying.

cards.title: The Burned Mill
cards.rules: A mill, still smoking. {dragon} took a dump on it an hour ago. Everyone pours out a sip.

cards.title: Droppings
cards.rules: A dragon turd, big enough to sit in. Nobody sits in it. Last to say 'nope' drinks 2.

cards.title: The Old Song
cards.rules: A shepherd sings a filthy song about {dragon}. Everyone hums along. Nobody knows it.

cards.title: The Sloppy Goat
cards.rules: Sticky floors, stickier sheets. Everyone gives their left neighbor a tavern-wench name.

cards.title: The Crooked Lantern
cards.rules: A crooked inn, a straight fire, a one-toothed barmaid. Everyone names their best moment so far.

cards.title: A Hayloft
cards.rules: A warm hayloft, and the farmer's kid keeps checking on you. Everyone names their battle mount.

cards.title: The Ferry House
cards.rules: Everyone's soaked to the taint. Everyone hypes their left neighbor like a herald.

cards.title: A Shepherd's Hut
cards.rules: A shepherd shares his bread and his theories about the queen. Everyone names a snack to kill for.

cards.title: The Pilgrims' Rest
cards.rules: Monks who brew, and brew hard. Everyone confesses one thing they'd never tell their mother.

cards.title: The Drunken Dwarf
cards.rules: The dwarf who runs it arm-wrestles every guest, naked. Everyone gives their left a dwarf name.

cards.title: A Painted Wagon
cards.rules: Actors let you sleep in their wagon. It smells like sex. Everyone strikes a heroic pose on three.

cards.title: The Inn Is a Mimic
cards.rules: The inn has teeth. The drawer fights their way out of bed. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It chews. Drink 8.
It chews. Drink 4.
You escape with the larder. Give 4.
Natural 20! You escape with the larder. Give 8.

cards.title: The Company's Table
cards.rules: The Gilded Company, asleep at the inn's best table. Everyone tiptoes.

cards.title: The Merchant's Plea
cards.rules: A merchant, robbed blind, wants his strongbox back. Everyone checks their own pockets, loudly.

cards.title: The Toll Booth
cards.rules: The bandits charge a toll to get in, and another to get out. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: You pay both. Drink 3.
You pay in fake coins. Give 3 to whoever looks richest.

dice.doubles: A pair! They pay you. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: The Bandit Bard
cards.rules: Sing the bandits a song about how great they are, 10 seconds. They hate it: drink 3.

cards.title: The Gatekeeper
cards.rules: Seven feet tall, one eye, and he wants the password. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wrong password. Drink 6.
Wrong password. Drink 3.
You walk in like you own it. Give 3 to whoever's royalty here.
Natural 20! You walk in like you own it. Give 6 to whoever's royalty here.

cards.title: One-Eyed Mag
cards.rules: The bandit chief. The strongbox is under her chair, and she's sitting on it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She recruits you. Finish your drink.
She robs you too. Drink 4.
You take the strongbox. Give 4.
Natural 20! You take the strongbox. Give 8.

jinx.name: Bandit's Honor
jinx.rule: Nobody speaks to the cursed player except through someone else. Slip: drink 1.

ally.name: Coin the Mule
ally.ritual: Whoever uses an item pats the table twice first. Forgets: drink 1.

phases.rules: She wants a duel of insults. Trade three with your left neighbor; the table judges. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: The Signpost
cards.rules: The goblins are on strike for dental. Crypt or tower? Everyone votes; the drawer decides.

cards.title: Charon's Obol
cards.rules: The dead want a coin for the crossing, and they call it in the air. Flip the coin.

outcomes.instruction: Tails. They called it. Drink 4.
Heads. They called it wrong. Give 4 to whoever looks deadest.

cards.title: The Wedding Ghosts
cards.rules: A wedding party from 1498 that died before the wedding night. They want one more dance. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the dance. Drink 8 and tell your worst hookup story.
You're in the dance. Drink 4 and tell your worst hookup story.
You lay them to rest with a song. Give 4.
Natural 20! You lay them to rest with a song. Give 8.

cards.title: Left on Read
cards.rules: A wraith with a list of everyone who ghosted it, and it reads the list aloud. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It reads the ones you did. Finish your drink.
Your name is on it, twice. Drink 4.
You read it a longer list. Give 4 to whoever holds the oldest grudge.
Natural 20! You read it a longer list. Give 8 to whoever holds the oldest grudge.

cards.title: The Skeleton Butler
cards.rules: A skeleton butler insists on announcing you, and gets your name wrong. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Announced as 'Sir Smallcock'. Drink 8.
Announced as 'Sir Smallcock'. Drink 4.
You correct him with dignity. Rename someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You correct him with dignity. Rename someone; they drink 8.

cards.title: The Vampire Bat
cards.rules: Staring contest with your right neighbor, who plays the bat. Blink or laugh first: drink 3.

jinx.name: Leeched
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player sips, their left neighbor sips too. Neighbor forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Fortune Teller
cards.rules: A dead fortune teller reads your palm and your diary. Cross your fingers, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Doomed. Drink 6, and confess your last hookup.
Doomed. Drink 3, and confess your last hookup.
You flip her table. Give 4.
Natural 20! You read her fortune back to her. She vanishes in shame. Give 8. She tells you how it ends.

jinx.name: Ill-Fated
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'I foresaw this' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Virgin Hunter
cards.rules: A vampire who only drinks from virgins. Say 'I'm no virgin' twice, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He doesn't believe you. Drink 8.
He doesn't believe you. Drink 4.
Garlic to the face. He drops something. Give 3.
Natural 20! Garlic to the face. He drops something. Give 6.

cards.title: The Bone Centipede
cards.rules: Something with a hundred bony legs and no manners. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It crawls up your pant leg. Drink 4, and shake it out.
You stomp it flat. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! You stomp it with both feet. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Die a Virgin
cards.rules: On three, point at who'll die a virgin, mummified. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Lich's Scribe
cards.rules: The lich's scribe tests you: your left neighbor asks three trivia questions. Miss two: drink 4.

jinx.name: Question Master
jinx.rule: Anyone who answers a question from the cursed player drinks 1.

cards.title: Tomb of Silence
cards.rules: No laughing in the tomb. The table gets 30 seconds to crack you. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: The Bone Tower
cards.rules: Stack the empties into a tower that stands for 5 seconds. Collapse: drink 4.

cards.title: Backwards Chant
cards.rules: Wake the dead: say the alphabet from Z to A in 20 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Séance
cards.rules: Hands joined, you summon a spirit: a dead pervert. Make someone laugh in 20 seconds, or drink 4.

cards.title: Collapsing Floor
cards.rules: The floor gives way. Last to grab the edge of the table with both hands drinks 2.

cards.title: Dart Wall
cards.rules: Little holes in both walls. Then a click. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Darted, right in the asshole. Drink 6 standing.
Darted, right in the asshole. Drink 3 standing.
You limbo under them. Give 2.
Natural 20! You limbo under them. Give 4.

cards.title: Fog of Regret
cards.rules: A green fog that smells like your worst night ever. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flashbacks. Drink 6.
Flashbacks. Drink 3.
You hold your breath. Give 2 to whoever had the worst night.
Natural 20! You hold your breath. Give 4 to whoever had the worst night.

jinx.name: Flashback
jinx.rule: The cursed player shudders at every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Rolling Skull
cards.rules: A giant stone skull rolls down the corridor. Everyone hums doom music while you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It rolls you flat. Drink 6.
It rolls you flat. Drink 3.
You dive into a side tomb. Give 2, and take a bow.
Natural 20! You dive into a side tomb. Give 4, and take a bow.

cards.title: Skeleton Crew
cards.rules: A skeleton crew wants a toast off a femur. Rattle your bone, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Off the femur. Drink 6.
Off the femur. Drink 3.
You knock their bones loose. Give 3.
Natural 20! You knock their bones loose. Give 6.

cards.title: The Ghoul Choir
cards.rules: Twelve ghouls singing your name, off key. Hum one note with them, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You join in. Drink 6.
You join in. Drink 3.
You conduct them into a wall. Give 3.
Natural 20! You conduct them into a wall. Give 6.

cards.title: The Zombie Lodger
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, naming a chore you skipped. The zombie bites whoever holds it.

timer.end: It bites. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Ghoul Knight
cards.rules: A ghoul knight still guarding a king three hundred years gone. He wants a duel. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He drops his sword on you. Drink 4.
You out-fence a corpse. Bow, then give 4.

dice.doubles: You salute the dead king, and he lets you pass. Everyone else bows or drinks 4.

cards.title: Skeleton Minstrels
cards.rules: Three skeletons with lutes. Everyone twerks for 10 seconds; the worst twerk drinks 3.

cards.title: Your Own Eulogy
cards.rules: Give your own eulogy in 10 seconds. The table says if it moved them. Not moved: drink 4.

cards.title: The Grabbing Hands
cards.rules: Hands grab from every coffin. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four ankles grabbed. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Ghost Hunters
cards.rules: A band of ghost hunters is sure you're a ghost, and they want proof. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You do the voice. Drink 6, then moan for them.
You do the voice. Drink 3, then moan for them.
You charge them for the sighting. Give 3.
Natural 20! You charge them for the sighting. Give 6.

cards.title: The Bone Dice
cards.rules: A skeleton's finger-bone dice. Win, then cash out or throw again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Snake eyes. Drink 8.
Snake eyes. Drink 4.
He clacks his jaw. Give 3.
Natural 20! He clacks his jaw. Give 6.

cards.title: Cursed Idol
cards.rules: A gold idol on a plinth. Nothing bad could possibly happen. Grab it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 6.
The plinth bleeds. So do you. Drink 3.
Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 4.
Natural 20! Real gold, and something rattling inside. Give 8.

jinx.name: Idol Worship
jinx.rule: Everyone bows to the cursed player before speaking to them. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Box of Teeth
cards.rules: A box full of teeth and, at the back, one potion. Shake it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It tips onto you. Drink 8.
It tips onto you. Drink 4.
Clunk. Give 3 to whoever heard it.
Natural 20! Clunk. Give 6 to whoever heard it.

cards.title: The Sarcophagus
cards.rules: A stone coffin with OPEN ME scratched on the lid, from the inside. Open it, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something farts in your face. It held that in for 2,000 years. Drink 8.
Something farts in your face. It held that in for 2,000 years. Drink 4.
Just a very nice shield. Give 4, then knock on the table twice.
Natural 20! Just a very nice shield. Give 8, then knock on the table twice.

cards.title: The Offering Bowl
cards.rules: A bowl of coins left for the dead, and an untouched potion. Tap the table: a coin for the dead.

cards.title: Candlelit Alcove
cards.rules: Someone left candles and a barrel of clean water. Everyone drinks water. Yes, really.

cards.title: The Ossuary
cards.rules: A banquet hall of bones, shut for centuries, with one last round. Everyone toasts the dead.

cards.title: The Grave Robber
cards.rules: A grave robber with a cart of stolen goods and no questions asked. Prices are firm.

cards.title: The Undertaker
cards.rules: He measures you for a coffin while he sells you things. Very thorough around the inseam.

cards.title: The Split
cards.rules: The tunnel splits. Left: silence. Right: drums, chanting, maybe an orgy.

cards.title: The Locked Door
cards.rules: A key in the lock, and a sign: DO NOT. Something knocks from the other side.

cards.title: Mimic Coffin
cards.rules: A coffin that coughs up treasure until it bites. Cash out or knock again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8. It follows you home.
It bites. Drink 4.
It coughs something up. Give 3.
Natural 20! It coughs something up. Give 6.

ally.name: Chester
ally.ritual: Chester holds the satchel. Ask him nicely before using an item.

cards.title: Your Epitaph
cards.rules: Everyone says what their tombstone will say. The table picks the best; they give 3.

cards.title: Skull Face
cards.rules: Everyone pulls their best skull face at once. The table picks the scariest; they give 2.

cards.title: Bone Count
cards.rules: Count off around the table, skipping every multiple of three. Whoever messes up drinks 2.

cards.title: Candlelight
cards.rules: Phone lights up: a moment of silence for the fallen. Anyone who talks drinks 1.

cards.title: Play Dead
cards.rules: On three, everyone plays dead. First to move, laugh or blink drinks 2.

elite.title: The Crypt Matron
elite.rules: The crypt's oldest ghost tends the dead like children. She does not like visitors. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She tucks you into a coffin. Drink 10, then say goodnight.
She tucks you into a coffin. Drink 5, then say goodnight.
You promise to wipe your feet. She packs you something for the road. Give 5.
Natural 20! You promise to wipe your feet. She packs you something for the road. Give 10.

spoils.name: Matron's Basket
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Comes with a Healing Potion.

elite.title: Death's Apprentice
elite.rules: Death's apprentice is behind on his quota, and you'll do. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Collected. Drink 10.
Collected. Drink 5.
You fill out his scrolls wrong. He runs, and drops his hourglass. Give 5.
Natural 20! You fill out his scrolls wrong. He runs, and drops his hourglass. Give 10.

elite.title: The Bone Dragon
elite.rules: A dragon skeleton in a tiny hat, guarding a pile of buttons. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 10.
It lies down on you, hat and all. Drink 5.
You take the hat. It deflates. Give 5.
Natural 20! You take the hat. It deflates. Give 10.

elite.title: The Banshee Bride
elite.rules: She's been at the altar since 1388, and you look just like him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She screams your name. Drink 10.
She screams your name. Drink 5.
You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 5.
Natural 20! You object. She vanishes and drops her ring. Give 10.

spoils.name: Widow's Ring
spoils.rules: +2 to boss d20s. Bosses hurt 1 more.

cards.title: The Dead Ferryman
cards.rules: He'll row you past the worst of the crypt. Eyes shut for the crossing; first to peek drinks 2.

jinx.name: The Ferryman's Due
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'for the ferryman' before every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Hall of Kings
cards.rules: Twelve dead kings on twelve thrones, one empty. The drawer names who here would sit in it.

cards.title: The Weeping Statue
cards.rules: A naked stone queen weeps healing tears. Everyone keeps a straight face, and eyes up.

jinx.name: Stone Tears
jinx.rule: The cursed player sobs loudly before every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Your Own Grave
cards.rules: A headstone with tonight's date and the drawer's name. Everyone toasts.

cards.title: Death, Playing Chess
cards.rules: Death challenges the table's champion to rock-paper-scissors, best of three.

cards.title: The Bone Golem
cards.rules: Every bone in the crypt, stacked into one angry giant with one very big bone. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It falls on you. Drink 10.
It falls on you. Drink 5.
You knock out its keystone bone. Give 4.
Natural 20! It collapses into a pile. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: It pulls itself back together, mostly. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It groans and falls on you. Drink 10.
It groans and falls on you. Drink 5.
The last bone comes loose. Give 4.
Natural 20! The last bone comes loose. Give 8.

cards.title: The Crypt Guardian
cards.rules: Seven feet of armor at a door. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He throws you out of the crypt. Finish your drink.
He throws you down the stairs. Drink 5.
You get past one arm. Give 4.
Natural 20! You get past one arm. Give 8.

jinx.name: No First Names
jinx.rule: Nobody says a first name. Slip: drink 1.

spoils.name: Guardian's Lantern
spoils.rules: +1 to monster, trap and relic d20s.

phases.rules: Arm-wrestle your left neighbor, playing the guardian. Lose: drink 4.

cards.title: The Dancing Dead
cards.rules: A skeleton fiddler plays the dead to their feet. Everyone dances, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He plays you off your feet. Drink 10.
He plays you off your feet. Drink 5.
You snap a string. Give 4.
Natural 20! You take the fiddle. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: The Fiddle
spoils.rules: Natural 20 on a 19 or 20. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: He plays faster. Freestyle four filthy lines about the table, in rhyme. Stop or stall: drink 4.

cards.title: The Lich Lord
cards.rules: His soul is in a jeweled cup. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You drink his soul. Finish your drink.
His soul is very strong. Drink 5.
You smash the cup. Give 4.
Natural 20! You smash the cup. Give 8. You drink his soul by mistake.

spoils.name: Phylactery
spoils.rules: −1 max heart. Comes with a Phoenix Feather.

spoils.name: Lich's Crown
spoils.rules: +1 to boss d20s. Natural 20 on a 19 or 20.

phases.rules: He pours his soul into a second cup. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You drink the wrong one. Drink 5.
You drink both. Drink 4.
He drinks yours. Drink 3.
You smash one. Give 3.
You smash both. Give 4.
You make him drink his own soul. Everyone else drinks 2.

jinx.name: Undead
jinx.rule: The cursed player moans like a horny zombie before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Crypt Keeper
cards.rules: Every soul down here owes him a coin, and so do you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He collects from you. Drink 10.
He collects from you. Drink 5.
You pay the last toll, and the dead rest. Give 4.
Natural 20! You buy the whole crypt. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Grave Goods
spoils.rules: Comes with a Lucky Coin and a Tower Shield.

phases.rules: Name five embarrassing things buried with a king, in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: Last Rites
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'rest in peace' whenever a card is put aside. Misses one: drink 1.

cards.title: The Gargoyle
cards.rules: Stare-down with your left neighbor, playing the gargoyle. Blink or laugh first: drink 4.

jinx.name: Stone-Faced
jinx.rule: The cursed player may not smile. Caught smiling: drink 1.

cards.title: The Living Spellbook
cards.rules: A spellbook flaps at you, reading itself aloud. Shush it, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It reads your diary aloud. The sex parts. Drink 8.
It reads your diary aloud. The sex parts. Drink 4.
You slam it shut. Shush someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You read it back to itself, and it falls asleep. Give 8.

cards.title: The Stuck Apprentice
cards.rules: An apprentice stuck halfway through a wall, ass out, since a teleport went wrong. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He grabs your ankle. Drink 8.
He grabs your ankle. Drink 4.
You pull him free. Pick his new master; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You pull him free. Pick his new master; they drink 8.

cards.title: The Clay Golem
cards.rules: Nine feet of clay guarding the stair, and it wants the password. Guess one aloud, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wrong password, twice. Drink 8, then water.
It squeezes you into a new shape. Drink 4.
You smudge the word on its forehead. It sits down. Give 4.
Natural 20! You smudge the word on its forehead. It sits down. Give 8.

cards.title: Mana Burn
cards.rules: Everyone presses a thumb to their forehead. Last to say 'mana burn' drinks 3.

cards.title: The Wizard's Portrait
cards.rules: Read alone who the portrait shows, start the clock, and describe them. The table guesses.

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

cards.title: The Empty Armor
cards.rules: An empty suit of armor clanks toward you, very politely. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bows, then hits you. Drink 8.
It bows, then hits you. Drink 4.
You knock its helmet off. Clank at someone; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You knock its helmet off. Clank at someone; they drink 8.

jinx.name: Statue
jinx.rule: Whenever the cursed player says 'freeze', the last to stop moving drinks 1.

cards.title: The Imp
cards.rules: Imp-tail wrestle: link pinkies with your right neighbor and pull. Let go first: drink 4.

cards.title: The Burning Mage
cards.rules: A fire mage in the tower's cold room, on fire, insisting he meant to be. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He hugs you for warmth. Drink 8.
He hugs you for warmth. Drink 4.
You put him out. Give 4 to the most flammable player here.
Natural 20! You put him out. Give 8 to the most flammable player here.

jinx.name: Shrinkage
jinx.rule: The cursed player says 'it's the cold' before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Love Potion
cards.rules: A walking love potion with a cork for a hat. Lick your lips, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It splashes you, and now you're horny. Drink 8.
It splashes you, and now you're horny. Drink 4.
You pull its cork. It's defenseless. Give 3.
Natural 20! You pull its cork. It's defenseless. Give 6.

cards.title: The Cold Spell
cards.rules: The wind wants something colder than itself. Say the coldest line you can. Nobody winces: drink 4.

cards.title: Petrified
cards.rules: Strike your most dramatic pose and hold it, stone still, for 15 seconds. Move: drink 4.

cards.title: The Pickup Spell
cards.rules: Cast a pickup line on your left neighbor, said like a spell. The table groans: drink 4.

cards.title: Spell It Out
cards.rules: Name a magic word for every letter of SPELL in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: The Grease Spell
cards.rules: A grease spell by the door. It smells like lube. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flat on your back. Drink 6.
Flat on your back. Drink 3.
You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 3.
Natural 20! You triple-axel it. The table scores you; give 6.

cards.title: Falling Books
cards.rules: The shelves sway, and you just sneezed. Freeze, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One finds you. Drink 6.
One finds you. Drink 3.
You step aside, and it slams shut. Give 3.
Natural 20! You step aside, and it slams shut. Give 6.

cards.title: The Dare
cards.rules: Read alone what you touched on a dare, start the clock, and mime it. The table guesses.

timer.end: Time. Someone guessed it? Give 3. Nobody did? Drink 3.

cards.title: The Owl Familiars
cards.rules: Six owls in tiny spectacles say you're in their library. Hoot once, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Pecks, from all sides. Drink 6.
Pecks, from all sides. Drink 3.
You out-hoot them. Give 3.
Natural 20! You out-hoot them. Give 6.

cards.title: The Marching Brooms
cards.rules: A dozen enchanted brooms, sweeping in formation. Count to five out loud, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swept off your feet. Drink 6.
Swept off your feet. Drink 3.
You snap the lead broom. Give 3.
Natural 20! You snap the lead broom. Give 6.

cards.title: The Imp's Auction
cards.rules: An imp auctions the wizard's last potion. Bid sips clockwise; top bid drinks it.

cards.title: The Summoned Savage
cards.rules: A warrior summoned from a thousand years ago wants to know what a fork is. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: He clubs your fork. Drink 4.
You show him a spoon. Grunt at someone; they drink 4.

dice.doubles: He makes you chief. Everyone else grunts and drinks 4.

cards.title: The Juggling Imp
cards.rules: The imp juggles sparks around the table. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: Four sparks down four collars. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Incantation
cards.rules: Say 'which witch wished which wicked wish' three times fast. Fumble it: drink 4.

cards.title: The Cauldron
cards.rules: A cauldron is boiling over, and shaking. Roll d20 before it blows.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Potion everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 6.
Potion everywhere, mostly on you. Drink 3.
You take it off the fire in time. Give 3, piping hot.
Natural 20! You take it off the fire in time. Give 6, piping hot.

cards.title: The Apprentices
cards.rules: Five apprentices who only ever passed sex magic. Say 'abracadabra', then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They practice a fart spell on you. Drink 6.
They practice a fart spell on you. Drink 3.
You send them back to class. Give 3.
Natural 20! You send them back to class. Give 6.

cards.title: The Bottled Spell
cards.rules: A spell sealed in a bottle, glowing. Uncork it, or leave it.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's a curse. Drink 8.
It's a curse. Drink 4.
Something old and good. Give 4 to the oldest player here.
Natural 20! Something old and good. Give 8 to the oldest player here.

cards.title: The Locked Trunk
cards.rules: A wizard's trunk, scratched on the inside of the lid. Open it, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Something climbs out. Drink 8.
Something climbs out. Drink 4.
Robes and a lucky coin. Give 4 to whoever wants the robes.
Natural 20! Robes and a lucky coin. Give 8 to whoever wants the robes.

jinx.name: Hold Your Hat
jinx.rule: The cursed player keeps one hand on their head. Lets go: drink 1.

cards.title: The Lost Robe
cards.rules: A wizard's robe, a potion in the pocket, a stain on the front. Twirl in it like a wizard.

cards.title: The Spellbook Shelf
cards.rules: Jars of eyes and toes, and a training tome. Read its first line aloud; make it up.

cards.title: The Fireplace
cards.rules: A warm fire in a cold tower. Everyone huddles in and sips.

cards.title: Hot Cocoa
cards.rules: A pot of cocoa, still warm, and a note: FOR WHOEVER'S NEXT. Everyone sips, slowly.

cards.title: The Familiar
cards.rules: The wizard's cat runs a little shop out of the library, for treats.

cards.title: The Silenced Mage
cards.rules: A mage who cast silence on himself mid-sale. He sells by pointing.

cards.title: The Shortcut
cards.rules: A teleport circle chalked on the floor, half rubbed out. It might go up.

cards.title: The Mirrors
cards.rules: Walk past the dark mirrors, or step through the one with a naked you in it, waving.

cards.title: The Scrying Pool
cards.rules: A pool that shows the future. Look, then cash out or look again, harder. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You see your future. Drink 8.
You see your future. Drink 4.
A glimpse of treasure. Give 3.
Natural 20! A glimpse of treasure. Give 6.

cards.title: Mimic Bookcase
cards.rules: A bookcase with a heartbeat. It pays out until it bites. Cash out or open again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 8. It follows you home.
It bites. Drink 4.
A useful book. Give 3.
Natural 20! A useful book. Give 6.

ally.name: Chester
ally.ritual: Chester holds the satchel. Ask him nicely before using an item.

cards.title: The Wizard Walk
cards.rules: The drawer walks like a very old wizard to the nearest wall and back. Refuse: drink 3.

cards.title: Prophecy
cards.rules: Everyone prophesies their left neighbor's sex life. The table picks the best; they give 3.

cards.title: The Ritual
cards.rules: Everyone holds hands for the ritual. Anyone who won't drinks 2.

cards.title: Spellcraft
cards.rules: Everyone wiggles their fingers like a wizard casting, then takes a slow sip.

cards.title: Fireball Fight
cards.rules: On three, everyone throws a mime fireball at someone. Whoever is hit most drinks 2.

elite.title: The Frost Mage
elite.rules: She has never once let anything go, the temperature included. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She freezes you out. Drink 10.
She freezes you out. Drink 5.
You sing at her. She thaws. Give 5.
Natural 20! You sing at her. She thaws. Give 10.

elite.title: The Golem Butler
elite.rules: Eight feet of stone with a silver tray, and you just asked for no ice. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He dumps the tray on you. Drink 10.
He dumps the tray on you. Drink 5.
You ask for extra ice. He hands you his tray. Give 5.
Natural 20! You ask for extra ice. He hands you his tray. Give 10.

elite.title: The Tower Guard
elite.rules: The wizard keeps him for people who owe. You don't. He doesn't care. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He locks you in a cupboard. Drink 10.
He locks you in a cupboard. Drink 5.
You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 5.
Natural 20! You make him an offer. Pick someone who owes you; they drink 10.

elite.title: The Mirror Witch
elite.rules: She keeps her rivals in mirrors, and there's room for one more. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the mirror. Drink 10.
You're in the mirror. Drink 5.
You free a rival. Give 5 to whoever would look best in a mirror.
Natural 20! You free a rival. Give 10 to whoever would look best in a mirror.

cards.title: The Room of Doors
cards.rules: Three doors: one hums, one smokes, one is very polite. Everyone picks one aloud.

cards.title: The Library
cards.rules: Every book ever written, half of them smut. The drawer names the last book they read, or admits it.

jinx.name: Overdue
jinx.rule: The cursed player shushes anyone who talks over them. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Familiar's Exam
cards.rules: The wizard's cat tests you before you may pass. Everyone meows on three.

cards.title: The Wizard Is Home
cards.rules: The wizard's home, in slippers and nothing else, and delighted. Everyone compliments the tower.

cards.title: The Oldest Apprentice
cards.rules: An apprentice of ninety, still sweeping. The drawer asks what he has learned.

boon.name: Apprentice's Hat
boon.rules: +1 max heart.

cards.title: The Tower Itself
cards.rules: The tower wakes, and every door slams. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It drops you down a floor. Drink 10.
It drops you down a floor. Drink 5.
You find its heart-stone and pry it loose. Give 5.
Natural 20! You kick the front door off. Everyone else drinks 3.

phases.rules: The light's out. Eyes shut, touch the nose of your left neighbor on the first try. Miss: drink 4.

cards.title: The Mad Alchemist
cards.rules: He brews only exploding potions, and he never stops pouring. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You ask for seconds. Finish your drink.
Straight to the brain. Drink 5.
You ask for it neat. He weeps. Give 5.
Natural 20! You ask for it neat. He weeps. Give 10.

spoils.name: Bubbling Flask
spoils.rules: Comes with a Healing Potion and a Hired Sword.

phases.rules: He serves the house special. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It explodes. Drink 5.
You sip it slowly, like an adult. Give 5.

dice.doubles: You hand it back, and it explodes on him. Give 7.

jinx.name: Bubbles
jinx.rule: The cursed player ends every sentence with 'bloop'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Archmage
cards.rules: The oldest wizard alive. He doesn't move, and nothing near him does either. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You stop moving. Drink 10.
You stop moving. Drink 5.
You sneeze, and break his focus. Give 5.
Natural 20! You set his beard on fire. Everyone else drinks 3. He takes you on as a student.

jinx.name: Countdown
jinx.rule: The cursed player counts down from three, out loud, before every sip. Forgets: drink 1.

phases.rules: He casts a holding spell. Freeze while the table counts to 15. Move, laugh or blink: drink 4.

cards.title: The Puppet Master
cards.rules: A wizard with strings on every finger. Side bets: thumbs up or down; wrong bets drink 1. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You become a puppet. Finish your drink.
You dance for him. Drink 5.
You cut a string. He can't cope. Give 5.
Natural 20! You cut a string. He can't cope. Give 10.

phases.rules: He makes the table dance. Name six sex positions in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

cards.title: The Frozen Apprentice
cards.rules: The wizard's last apprentice, frozen mid-spell a hundred years ago, now thawing. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He finishes the spell, on you. Drink 10.
He finishes the spell, on you. Drink 5.
You tell him the wizard retired. He shatters. Give 5.
Natural 20! He thanks you and melts, politely. Everyone else drinks 3.

spoils.name: Thawed Heart
spoils.rules: +1 max heart. Every heal heals 1 more.

phases.rules: He asks what he missed. Name three new things in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

jinx.name: As I Was Saying
jinx.rule: The cursed player starts every sentence with 'As I was saying'. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: The Last Warm Fire
cards.rules: Past here, only {dragon}. Everyone warms their hands and names one thing they'll miss.

cards.title: A Campfire
cards.rules: A fire under the stars. Everyone tells the dirtiest rumor they've heard about {dragon}.

cards.title: The Monastery
cards.rules: Monks sworn to silence and to wine. Everyone stays silent a minute. First sound drinks 2.

cards.title: The Watchtower
cards.rules: A ruined tower; far off, smoke from {dragon}. Everyone toasts how far you've come.

cards.title: The Hermit's Cave
cards.rules: A hermit met {dragon} and won't say what happened. Everyone tells him some gossip.

cards.title: The Empty Fort
cards.rules: A fort abandoned when {dragon} woke. Everyone names who they'd want on its walls.

cards.title: The Hot Springs
cards.rules: Naked hot springs. Someone definitely peed. Everyone confesses one secret to the party.

cards.title: The Haunted Inn
cards.rules: The innkeeper is a ghost; {dragon} got him. Everyone hums his song on three.

cards.title: The Slayer's Widow
cards.rules: She keeps the inn now, and her husband's sword over the fire. Everyone raises a glass to him.

boon.name: Dragonbane
boon.rules: +2 to boss d20s.

cards.title: Chad's Autograph
cards.rules: Sir Chad is signing your gear with a sharpie shaped like himself. Roll d20 to stop him.

outcomes.instruction: Frozen to the bone. Your nipples could cut glass. Drink 5.
You dance in it. Everyone dances or drinks 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! Thundersnow strikes your cup and warms it. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: The Snow Fox
cards.rules: Guarding the rations: rock-paper-scissors with your right neighbor, best of 3. Lose: drink 5.

cards.title: To the Mountain
cards.rules: Give a toast to the mountain in 15 seconds, no 'um'. Say 'um': drink 5.

cards.title: Mountain Names
cards.rules: Name five famous mountains in 10 seconds. Stumble: drink 5.

cards.title: The Slow Dance
cards.rules: Slow dance with your right neighbor, eyes locked, hands visible, 10 seconds. Laugh: drink 5.

cards.title: The Summit Pose
cards.rules: Give the table your best heroic summit pose. The table votes it fake: drink 5.

cards.title: The Ledge
cards.rules: You lean over for the view, and the ice leans with you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You see your life flash. Drink 8.
You see your life flash. Drink 4.
You step back, cool. Give 4 to whoever gasped.
Natural 20! You step back, cool. Give 8 to whoever gasped.

cards.title: Snow Slide
cards.rules: Snow slides off the cliff above. Last to cover their head with both hands drinks 3.

cards.title: The Ice Bridge
cards.rules: The ice bridge cracks right under your foot. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You slide. Drink 8.
You slide. Drink 4.
You land it like a mountain goat. Shout 'goat!' and give 4.
Natural 20! You land it like a mountain goat. Shout 'goat!' and give 8.

cards.title: The Campfire Hog
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at who'd hog the campfire. Most fingers: drink 3.

cards.title: The Mountain Monks
cards.rules: Twenty monks meditating on the pass, and you're in their way. Bow, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They make you join. Drink 8.
They make you join. Drink 4.
You bow out. Give 4.
Natural 20! You bow out. Give 8.

cards.title: The Griffin Flight
cards.rules: Twelve griffins in a V, on a strafing run. Duck, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Direct hit. It's griffin shit. Drink 8.
Direct hit. It's griffin shit. Drink 4.
You duck behind a rock. Give 4.
Natural 20! You duck behind a rock. Give 8.

cards.title: The Snowball Imp
cards.rules: A snowball imp pelts the table. Roll four dice.

dice.instruction: It hits four bad sides. You drink {first}; the next three clockwise drink {second}, {third} and {fourth}.

cards.title: The Hot Spring Wizard
cards.rules: A naked 'wizard' in a hot spring wants your drink. Hold it close, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He's a wizard. Drink 10.
He's a wizard. Drink 5.
He's just an old man. Give 5 to whoever believed him.
Natural 20! He is a wizard, and he likes you. Give 10, and he makes it snow.

cards.title: The Avalanche
cards.rules: Light the fuse. Pass a cup clockwise, each 'shh' quieter. The avalanche hits whoever holds it.

timer.end: RUMBLE. Whoever is holding the cup drinks 3.

cards.title: The Heckling Yeti
cards.rules: A yeti on the next peak heckles you. Roast him back in 10 seconds. Weak roast: drink 5.

cards.title: The Snow Shelf
cards.rules: The snow shelf above you is sagging. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Buried. Drink 8.
Buried. Drink 4.
You poke it from a safe distance. Point at someone; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You poke it from a safe distance. Point at someone; they drink 6.

cards.title: The Frost Wedding
cards.rules: A frost-giant wedding wants the view, and you're in every portrait. Smile, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're in the portrait forever. Drink 8.
You're in the portrait forever. Drink 4.
You show them a better spot. Give 4.
Natural 20! You show them a better spot. Give 8.

cards.title: The Spyglass
cards.rules: An old spyglass pointed at a castle far away. Look, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Someone looks back. Drink 10.
Someone looks back. Drink 5.
A flask hidden in the tube. Spy on someone; they drink 5.
Natural 20! A flask hidden in the tube. Spy on someone; they drink 10.

cards.title: The Watchtower
cards.rules: A ladder up an old watchtower, and something glinting at the top. Climb, or don't.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! A rung gives. Drink 10.
A rung gives. Drink 5.
The best view in the realm. Point at a far peak; give 5.
Natural 20! The best view in the realm. Point at a far peak; give 10.

jinx.name: Hydrate
jinx.rule: The cursed player sips water between every drink. Forgets: drink 1.

cards.title: Left Behind
cards.rules: A frozen pack in the snow: one boot, one condom and a smoke bomb. Blow on your hands.

cards.title: The Frozen Feast
cards.rules: A whole camp left its supper and never came back. Pour a splash for them.

cards.title: The Frozen Scout
cards.rules: A scout frozen at her post, a potion still on her belt. Everyone salutes her.

cards.title: The View
cards.rules: The whole realm, laid out below. Everyone stops, looks, and drinks to it.

cards.title: The Fire Pit
cards.rules: A fire pit and a ring of rocks. Everyone sits closer than they need to and sips.

cards.title: The Yak Herder
cards.rules: A yak herder with a sled of supplies and a spot by his fire, for a price.

cards.title: A Cry for Help
cards.rules: A horn from a stuck caravan up the pass: three short blasts, for help.

cards.title: The Ice Cave
cards.rules: Climb over the ridge, or crawl through the ice cave, where someone is shouting.

cards.title: Sled Racing
cards.rules: Bet on the sled races down the slope. Win, then cash out or bet again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Yours flips. Drink 10.
Yours flips. Drink 5.
Yours wins. Give 4.
Natural 20! Yours wins. Give 8.

cards.title: Mimic Snowdrift
cards.rules: A snowdrift that grows prizes until it bites. Cash out or dig again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites. Drink 10. It follows you home.
It bites. Drink 5.
Something glints. Give 4.
Natural 20! Something glints. Give 8.

ally.name: Chester
ally.ritual: Chester holds the satchel. Ask him nicely before using an item.

cards.title: Peak Toast
cards.rules: Everyone toasts something they can see from up here. Repeat a toast: drink 2.

cards.title: Shooting Star
cards.rules: The drawer makes a wish out loud. If the table thinks it's lame, the drawer drinks 2.

cards.title: Group Portrait
cards.rules: Everyone squeezes into one pose for the painter. Anyone cut off or blinking drinks 2.

cards.title: Fresh Air
cards.rules: Everyone takes a deep breath of fresh air. Then a sip.

cards.title: First Down
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at who'll puke first on the way down. Most fingers: give 3.

elite.title: The Frost Lord
elite.rules: He owns the pass, the peaks and, he thinks, you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He has you thrown off the mountain, gently. Drink 12.
He has you thrown off the mountain, gently. Drink 6.
You claim the peak below his. Give 6 to the richest-looking player here.
Natural 20! You claim the peak below his. Give 12 to the richest-looking player here.

spoils.name: Frost Lord's Key
spoils.rules: +1 satchel slot. Comes with a Healing Potion.

elite.title: The Yeti King
elite.rules: The biggest yeti there is. Every other yeti on the mountain just turned to look. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fur fist. Drink 12.
Fur fist. Drink 6.
You crown yourself. Give 6, split among your subjects.
Natural 20! You crown yourself. Give 12, split among your subjects.

elite.title: The Storm Giant
elite.rules: He throws lightning for fun, and tonight he brought you some. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Struck. Drink 12.
Struck. Drink 6.
You ground him. Touch someone's shoulder, zap; they drink 6.
Natural 20! You ground him. Touch someone's shoulder, zap; they drink 12.

spoils.name: Storm Coat
spoils.rules: Every heal heals 1 more. Traps hurt 1 less.

elite.title: The Griffin Rider
elite.rules: He landed on the pass and won't leave until somebody pays. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're paying. Drink 12.
You're paying. Drink 6.
Free ride. Pick a co-pilot; you both give 6.
Natural 20! Free ride. Pick a co-pilot; you both give 12.

cards.title: The Frozen Army
cards.rules: A hundred knights in ice, swords raised at {dragon}. Everyone freezes for three seconds.

ally.name: The Frozen Knight
ally.ritual: The drawer says 'for the king' before every swing.

cards.title: The Wind Shrine
cards.rules: Prayer flags, and an old monk who has seen {dragon}. Last to bow to the wind drinks 2.

cards.title: The Glass Bridge
cards.rules: A bridge of clear ice, or the long way round. Everyone holds their breath to cross.

cards.title: The Yeti's Tea Party
cards.rules: A yeti pours tea for everyone. Everyone pours for their left neighbor.

cards.title: The Old Dragonslayer
cards.rules: An old dragonslayer on a rock, missing an arm and one ball. Everyone asks him one question.

cards.title: The Hanged Man Returns
cards.rules: The man you freed was a thief. He's picked the lair's lock for you. Everyone thanks him.

cards.title: His Brother
cards.rules: The hanged man's brother wants a word about the gallows. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He has a lot of words. Drink 8.
He has a lot of words. Drink 4.
He takes the hint. Give 3.
Natural 20! He takes the hint. Give 6.

cards.title: The Fair Folk Collect
cards.rules: The fair folk are here about that gift. Everyone looks innocent.

cards.title: The Lord Remembers
cards.rules: The lord whose feast you crashed sends wine, with a note. Everyone toasts bad manners.

cards.title: The Hag Is Owed
cards.rules: The hag wants the rest of her price. Everyone shudders.

jinx.name: The Hag's Due
jinx.rule: The cursed player speaks only in questions. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: The Ferryman Waits
cards.rules: The ferryman you stiffed is waiting. The drawer pays him in compliments for ten seconds.

cards.title: The Goblin Posse
cards.rules: The goblins you robbed have followed you all this way. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! They take it all back, with interest. Drink 8.
They take it all back, with interest. Drink 4.
They flee, dropping a coin. Give 3.
Natural 20! They flee, dropping a coin. Give 6.

cards.title: A Gift from Home
cards.rules: The village you saved sent bread, still warm. Everyone breaks off a piece.

cards.title: The One You Left
cards.rules: They did it themselves, and they're not speaking to you. Everyone drinks 2.

cards.title: Chad's Moustache
cards.rules: Sir Chad rides by with an inked moustache he hasn't found yet. Nobody laughs, or drinks 2.

cards.title: A Grave by the Road
cards.rules: A cairn for the friend you lost. Everyone toasts them by name.

cards.title: Sir Chad Begs
cards.rules: Sir Chad, cape on fire, wants in. He keeps what he took, and the credit. Everyone votes.

ally.name: Sir Chad Thundercock
ally.ritual: Everyone says 'nice one, Chad' after every swing.

cards.title: Fingerbang's Offer
cards.rules: Lady Fingerbang gives it all back if she can come. She crosses her heart, with your hand. Vote.

ally.name: Lady Fingerbang
ally.ritual: Lose a fight she is in and she leaves with the whole satchel.

cards.title: The Final Exam
cards.rules: Sensei Saggynuts blocks the door. 'One last lesson.' He's not coming along. Everyone groans.

cards.title: Chuck Begs to Serve
cards.rules: Chuck the Cuck, on his knees, begs to serve you. He'll just watch. Take him and flip a coin.

ally.name: Chuck the Cuck
ally.ritual: The drawer stares someone down as Chuck. First to look away drinks 1.

cards.title: Settle the Debt
cards.rules: Gary Shitwhistle tallies your debt at the door. It's itemised. Pay in drinks, or refuse.

cards.title: Your Ballad, Half Done
cards.rules: Dame Queefington has your ballad half written. How it ends depends on you. Vote.

ally.name: Dame Queefington
ally.ritual: Everyone hums along whenever she plays.

cards.rules: Sensei Saggynuts, pinned under a claw: 'I was wrong about you.' Save him, or leave him.

cards.rules: Sir Chad wants the dragon and the credit. Kick his ass at the door. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He poses mid-fight and still hits you. Drink 8.
He poses mid-fight and still hits you. Drink 4.
His cape catches fire again. He runs. Give 4.
Natural 20! His cape catches fire again. He runs. Give 8.

boon.name: Chad's Cape
boon.rules: +1 to boss d20s.

cards.rules: Lady Fingerbang wants the hoard, all of it, and your boots. Duel her. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She has your boots now. Drink 8.
She has your boots now. Drink 4.
You turn her out, pockets and all. Give 4.
Natural 20! You turn her out, pockets and all. Give 8.

boon.name: Fingerbang's Purse
boon.rules: +1 satchel slot.

cards.title: Sensei's Last Lesson
cards.rules: Sensei Saggynuts raises his stick. 'Again.' Pass the final exam. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! 'Again.' Drink 8.
'Again.' Drink 4.
He nods, once. Best day of your life. Give 4.
Natural 20! He nods, once. Best day of your life. Give 8.

boon.name: Sensei's Stick
boon.rules: +1 to every battle d20.

cards.title: Chuck Stops Watching
cards.rules: Chuck the Cuck finally picks up a sword. Yours. Duel him at the door. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He's actually good at this. Drink 8.
He's actually good at this. Drink 4.
He drops it and goes back to watching. Give 4.
Natural 20! He drops it and goes back to watching. Give 8.

boon.name: Chuck's Notebook
boon.rules: Every heal heals 1 more.

cards.title: The Audit
cards.rules: Gary Shitwhistle opens a full audit at the door. Three rounds. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He finds something. Drink 8.
He finds something. Drink 4.
You find his expenses. Give 4.
Natural 20! You find his expenses. Give 8.

boon.name: Gary's Whistle
boon.rules: Once a region, blow it to call off your rival.

cards.title: The Final Verse
cards.rules: Dame Queefington wants the last verse. Duel her for the pen. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She sings your defeat. Drink 8.
She sings your defeat. Drink 4.
You snap her lute string. Give 4.
Natural 20! You snap her lute string. Give 8.
